title: EthenaPay Cashback: Rates Paid to Oct 9, 2026
headline: What EthenaPay's card cashback paid
name: EthenaPay cashback review
description: Isolated EthenaPay card payments earned a median 3.98% in cashback, but the Standard tier stops at $115 a month. September came to 2.62% of card spend.
imageAlt: Scatter chart of 580 EthenaPay wallets with $10 or more of card payments from September 1 to 28, 2026 and some cashback paid from September 3 to October 1, each placed by the two amounts in dollars, the cashback at Chainlink's AVAX price, on log scales. Lines show the Standard, Pro and VIP schedules. Light-spending wallets sit near the Standard line, 28 heavy-spending wallets sit on the flat Standard line at about $115, 12 sit near the VIP line and 6 near the Pro line.
